da_method: DESeq2 (pydeseq2 Wald, one model on all 12 samples)
treatment: TD post vs pre; CP post vs pre; CP vs TD at pre; CP vs TD at post

stop_reason: No exercise contrast: the only factor is miR-486 mimic vs scramble miRNA transfection in C2C12 myoblasts (S2.8.p1). It tests a miRNA's effect in vitro, not exercise, so it cannot answer how exercise affects gene expression.

SuperSeries: its samples are the union of GSE218103 (human EV miRNA, exercise) and GSE219099 (mouse C2C12, no exercise). No single design spans two species and assays; the exercise contrast is identical to and analysed in case GSE218103, so re-running it here would duplicate it.
